description: This file defines the 'MockEndpoint' class, which models a network device endpoint with associated clusters and attributes. It provides methods to manage clusters, retrieve information about the endpoint, and enable or disable the endpoint.

classes.name: MockEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a network device endpoint with functionality to manage clusters and retrieve endpoint-related information.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes a MockEndpoint with specified parameters, defaulting to no manufacturer or model and no mfg-specific attributes.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes a MockEndpoint with specified parameters, including manufacturer, model, hardware version, and whether it has a manufacturing-specific attribute.

methods.name: addCluster
methods.description: Adds a given cluster to either the server or client cluster map based on its direction.

methods.name: getServerCluster
methods.description: Retrieves a server cluster by its cluster ID.

methods.name: getClientCluster
methods.description: Retrieves a client cluster by its cluster ID.

methods.name: getServerClusterIds
methods.description: Returns sorted array of server cluster IDs associated with this endpoint.

methods.name: getClientClusterIds
methods.description: Returns sorted array of client cluster IDs associated with this endpoint.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the endpoint.
